features.name: Project Setup & Agent Harness
features.description: Svelte 5 + SvelteKit library package harness with bun, typescript, svelte-check, prettier, eslint, publint, and .agents workspace configuration.

features.name: Core Primitive Utilities & Actions
features.description: Base utilities: typed Svelte 5 context helpers, unique ID generator, event composition utility, Portal component, and click-outside / escape-keydown handlers.

features.name: Button & Toggle Primitives
features.description: Unstyled Button and Toggle primitives supporting pressed state, aria-pressed, keyboard space/enter triggers, and element delegation.

features.name: Checkbox & Switch Primitives
features.description: Accessible Checkbox (checked, unchecked, indeterminate, hidden input for forms) and Switch (toggle switch with aria-checked and thumb).

features.name: Radio Group Primitive
features.description: RadioGroup (Root, Item, Indicator) with roving tabindex, arrow navigation (horizontal/vertical), and form validation support.

features.name: Collapsible & Accordion Primitives
features.description: Collapsible (expand/collapse panel) and Accordion (single or multiple expansion, header, trigger, content, arrow navigation, WAI-ARIA compliant).

features.name: Dialog & Alert Dialog Primitives
features.description: Modal Dialog and AlertDialog: Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content, Title, Description, Close. Includes focus trapping, scroll locking, and Escape dismiss.

features.name: Popover & Tooltip Primitives
features.description: Popover (anchor, floating positioning, outside click dismiss) and Tooltip (hover/focus triggers, customizable delay, skip delay across items).

features.name: Dropdown Menu Primitive
features.description: DropdownMenu: Root, Trigger, Portal, Content, Item, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, Submenu, Separator with roving focus and typeahead.

features.name: Tabs Primitive
features.description: Tabs: Root, List, Trigger, Content. Supports automatic/manual activation, horizontal/vertical orientation, and roving tabindex.

features.name: Slider & Progress Primitives
features.description: Slider (single and multi-thumb range slider with keyboard step control) and Progress (determinate and indeterminate progress bar with ARIA attributes).

features.name: Select Primitive
features.description: Select: Root, Trigger, Value, Portal, Content, Viewport, Item, Group, Label. Full keyboard navigation, typeahead, and form value synchronization.

features.name: Separator & Scroll Area Primitives
features.description: Separator (semantic/decorative divider) and ScrollArea (custom styled scrollbar thumb and track with native scrolling support).

features.name: Toast Primitive
features.description: Toast: Provider, Root, Title, Description, Action, Close, Viewport. Swipe to dismiss, timers, and accessible aria-live region announcements.

features.name: Interactive Showcase & Verification Gallery
features.description: Comprehensive interactive demo gallery in routes demonstrating all primitives with zero styling, custom styling, and keyboard testing.

features.name: Monorepo workspace split
features.description: Split single-project repo into docs/ showcase app + packages/svbase library; nested svbase harness, tooling configs, and agent config into the package; root is a thin delegating orchestrator with zero devDeps.
features.evidence: add61d7 (Phase 0 pnpm defs), 7324aa1 (Task 1 lib move), 54a7c36 (Task 2 docs + harness move), docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-24-workspace-split.md

features.name: Subpath exports for primitives, actions, and utils
features.description: Package exports map: root plus explicit per-primitive subpaths (all 21), bare ./actions and ./utils indexes, and ./actions/* + ./utils/* wildcards. Verified by svelte-package output + publint.

features.name: mdsvex docs pages with svelte.dev-style theme
features.description: All 20 docs routes converted to mdsvex (.svx); dark serif docs theme with topbar, filterable sidebar, On-this-page rail (inline rehype heading ids), and filename+copy code blocks. Docs app self-contained with pinned nodejs22.x Vercel runtime.

features.name: Docs Tailwind-only chrome with Inter font
features.description: Removed all custom docs CSS classes; prose gets Tailwind utilities from an extended rehype plugin, Kbd.svelte component, inline demo chrome; Inter Variable as default sans; orange brand kept via tokens.

features.name: Form story: field, input, form, fieldset
features.description: Field root/label/control/description/error with native constraint + custom sync validation (dirty-suppressed valueMissing, submit bypasses it), headless Input auto-registering in fields, Form validating all fields on submit with values/errors and focus-first-invalid plus reset clearing, Fieldset disabled grouping.

features.name: Combobox + autocomplete
features.description: Filterable single-select with text input and listbox popup (command-palette pattern) plus free-text autocomplete with suggestions; reuses popover positioning and field input integration.

features.name: Context menu + menubar
features.description: Right-click context menu with cursor anchoring and touch long-press plus coordinated menu bar with cross-menu traversal, reusing the dropdown-menu item engine.

features.name: Drawer / sheet
features.description: Side-panel modal reusing the dialog focus/scroll-lock controller with directional placement (left/right/top/bottom).

features.name: Navigation menu
features.description: Hover-intent site navigation menus with viewport-positioned content panels and keyboard traversal across triggers.

features.name: Avatar
features.description: Image avatar with loading states and text fallback (initials), plus configurable display delay.

features.name: Number field
features.description: Spinbutton with increment/decrement controls, keyboard stepping, min/max/step/clamp validation integrated with Field.

features.name: OTP field
features.description: Segmented one-time-code input with auto-advance, backspace navigation, and paste-to-distribute support.

features.name: Toggle group + checkbox group
features.description: Grouped selection: single/multiple toggle group with roving focus, and checkbox group with mixed select-all state.

features.name: Toolbar
features.description: Roving-tabindex toolbar grouping controls with orientation, disabled-item skipping, and group/link subparts.

features.name: Preview card
features.description: Hover preview panel (hover-card pattern) with open/close delays reusing tooltip timing and popover positioning.

features.name: Meter
features.description: Scalar gauge (role=meter) with min/max/value, low/high/optimum bands, sibling to progress.

features.name: Direction provider
features.description: RTL direction context consumed by roving navigation and floating positioning, replacing per-component direction props.
